subtitle: In the Kushan twilight, a poet braids Buddha’s path into shining Sanskrit verse

panels.shot: epic three-quarter view, low angle, wide frame
panels.action: Ashvaghosha stands on a monastery terrace overlooking a Kushan city, scroll in hand, robes stirred by a high wind, as distant caravans creep along the Silk Road under a vast, golden sky.

dialogue.text: In the age of the Kushans, as caravans crossed deserts and kings weighed doctrines, Ashvaghosha shaped the Buddha’s life into song that could travel farther than any rider.

i18n.hi: कुषाण युग में, जब कारवां रेगिस्तान पार करते हैं और राजा मत तौलते हैं, आश्वघोष बुद्ध का जीवन ऐसे गीत में गढ़ता है जो हर सवार से दूर तक जाए

panels.shot: slow push-in from wide landscape to medium on lone figure
panels.action: A young Ashvaghosha sits beneath a tree near Saketa, surrounded by palm-leaf manuscripts and simple monks, listening intently as an elder recites verses in Prakrit.

dialogue.text: In Saketa’s quiet monasteries, a boy grew among scriptures and stories, hearing the Buddha’s path in many tongues, and wondering how one voice might hold them all.

i18n.hi: साकेत के शांत विहारों में, एक बालक शास्त्रों और कथाओं के बीच बड़ा होता है, कई ज़बानों में बुद्ध की राह सुनकर सोचता है, क्या एक ही आवाज़ सबको थाम सकती है

panels.shot: over-the-shoulder close-up on manuscript and hand
panels.action: Ashvaghosha leans over a palm leaf, brows furrowed, carefully copying a line in neat Brahmi script, Sanskrit words flowing with deliberate grace.

dialogue.text: He learned meter and grammar, the old Vedic lore and new Buddhist thought, testing each word like a jewel, turning rough teachings into a polished Sanskrit line.

i18n.hi: वह छंद और व्याकरण, पुरानी वैदिक सीख और नई बौद्ध सोच सीखता है, हर शब्द को रत्न सा परखकर, कच्ची सीख को तराशी हुई संस्कृत पंक्ति में बदलता है

panels.shot: medium interior shot of modest hall, side angle
panels.action: Ashvaghosha stands in a simple assembly hall, reciting before monks and layfolk; his right hand is raised in measured emphasis, his face calm yet intense.

dialogue.speaker: ashvaghosha
dialogue.text: The prince’s renunciation is not loss, venerable ones—it is the world waking.

i18n.hi: राजकुमार का त्याग हानि नहीं है, venerable जन—यह तो जग का जागना है

panels.shot: low-angle wide of Kushan city and monastery complex
panels.action: A bustling Kushan city near Saketa spreads out: red-robed monks move among traders, stone stupas rise beside shrines, and within a monastery Ashvaghosha debates with other scholars.

dialogue.text: Around him, the Kushan realm bound north and south, Gandhara and the Ganges, linking caves, courts and caravanserais into one restless world of doctrine and doubt.

i18n.hi: उसके चारों ओर कुषाण साम्राज्य उत्तर–दक्षिण, गांधार से गंगा तक फैलता है, गुफाओं, दरबारों और सरायों को एक बेचैन जग में, मत और संशय से जोड़ता है

panels.shot: intimate close-up on Ashvaghosha’s face in candlelight
panels.action: By lamplight, Ashvaghosha stares at a blank leaf, the faint outline of a royal figure imagined in his gaze, while the lamp’s smoke curls upward.

dialogue.text: Many had preached the Buddha’s path. Ashvaghosha asked a harder thing: how to show enlightenment in a prince’s footsteps, so even the doubtful would be moved.

i18n.hi: बहुतों ने बुद्ध की राह सुनाई थी। आश्वघोष ने कठिन काम मांगा: राजकुमार के कदमों में बोध दिखाना, ताकि संदेही भी भीतर से हिल जाए

panels.shot: dynamic montage-style medium shot with implied progression
panels.action: Sequence within a single frame: Ashvaghosha sketches scenes of Kapilavastu, ascetic forests, and Bodh Gaya, his hand shifting across multiple leaves as verses gather around the Buddha’s life.

dialogue.text: Word by word, he wove the Buddhacarita—the ‘Deeds of the Buddha’—a full life-story, from palace ease to awakened calm, in measured Sanskrit that carried both beauty and doctrine.

i18n.hi: शब्द–शब्द कर उसने ‘बुद्धचरित’ बुना—‘बुद्ध के कर्म’—पूरा जीवन, राजमहल की सुख से जागृत शांति तक, ऐसे तौले संस्कृत में जो रूप भी रखे, सिद्धांत भी

panels.shot: wide shot inside monastery hall, slightly elevated angle
panels.action: In a grand monastery hall, monks sit in ordered rows as Ashvaghosha stands at the front, chanting a passage on the Great Departure; listeners lean forward, eyes bright.

dialogue.text: Buddhist halls had known sermons and lists, but now they heard kavya—ornate verse—that painted chariots, city dust, and quiet resolve, until the prince’s choice felt like their own.

i18n.hi: बौद्ध सभागारों ने उपदेश और सूचियाँ सुनी थीं, अब काव्य सुनते हैं—सजीली कविता—जो रथों, नगर–धूल और शांत संकल्प को रचती है, जब तक राजकुमार का चुनाव उनका अपना न लगे

panels.shot: medium two-thirds profile of Ashvaghosha among mixed audience
panels.action: Ashvaghosha recites to a mixed gathering: monks, Brahmin scholars, merchants from distant regions; some follow his arguments, others simply close their eyes at the cadence.

dialogue.text: His Sanskrit bridges worlds. Brahmin pundits hear familiar meters, merchants hear a tale, monks hear doctrine; in that shared listening, the Buddha’s path crosses old boundaries.

i18n.hi: उसकी संस्कृत दुनियाओं को जोड़ती है। ब्राह्मण पंडितों को जाने–पहचाने छंद, व्यापारियों को कथा, भिक्षुओं को धर्म दिखता है; इसी साझा सुनने में बुद्ध की राह पुरानी सरहदें पार करती है

panels.shot: slow push-in on Ashvaghosha seated beside another monk
panels.action: Seated beside a thoughtful monk representing Nanda, Ashvaghosha gestures toward him as if explaining; behind them, a faint vision of Nanda turning away from worldly pleasure is suggested through posture.

dialogue.text: In Saundarananda, he showed another struggle—the Buddha’s kinsman torn between desire and discipline—teaching that renunciation is not denial but a deeper, steadier joy.

i18n.hi: ‘सौन्दरानंद’ में वह एक और संघर्ष दिखाता है—बुद्ध का कुटुंबी, कामना और संयम में खिंचा—बताते हुए कि त्याग इनकार नहीं, बल्कि गहरी, स्थिर प्रसन्नता है

panels.shot: medium shot of Ashvaghosha with a scroll showing stage markings
panels.action: Ashvaghosha examines a scroll marked with dialogue cues, as if drafting a dramatic piece; in the background, monks discuss, and a faint suggestion of a simple stage appears.

dialogue.text: Later ages would speak of plays like Shariputraprakarana and link them to his hand. Fragile Turfan leaves hint at such drama, but the past keeps some secrets veiled.

i18n.hi: बाद की पीढ़ियाँ ‘शारिपुत्रप्रकरण’ जैसे नाटकों की बात करेंगी और उन्हें उसके हाथ से जोड़ेंगी। नाज़ुक तुर्फ़ान पत्ते ऐसे नाट्य का संकेत देते हैं, पर अतीत कुछ भेद ओट में रखता है

panels.shot: wide shot of Purushapura city and monastery complex, bird’s-eye
panels.action: From above, Purushapura glimmers with stupas, shrines, and Kushan buildings; within a large monastery, Ashvaghosha teaches a group of monks next to shelves of neatly arranged scrolls.

dialogue.text: As Kushan power reached north to Purushapura, monasteries there treasured texts from many lands. Ashvaghosha’s verses joined this growing library of Gandharan, Indian, and Central Asian learning.

i18n.hi: जब कुषाण शक्ति पुरुषपुरा तक उत्तर में पहुँची, वहाँ के विहारों ने कई देशी ग्रंथ सँजोए। आश्वघोष की पद्यावलियाँ गांधारी, भारतीय और मध्य एशियाई विद्या की इस बढ़ती लायब्रेरी में जुड़ गईं

panels.shot: medium shot of Ashvaghosha receiving a manuscript from a traveler
panels.action: A weathered caravan monk hands Ashvaghosha a bundle of scrolls; the poet accepts them with a slight bow, while behind them camels rest and traders converse in varied costumes.

dialogue.text: Caravan monks carried his poems along with other scriptures, trading teachings like rare spices. His Buddha became part of a portable India that rode with them across passes and oases.

i18n.hi: कारवां–भिक्षु उसके काव्य को अन्य सूत्रों संग ले चलते हैं, ज्ञान को दुर्लभ मसालों सा बाँटते हुए। उनका बुद्ध एक पोर्टेबल भारत बन जाता है, जो घाटियों और नख़लिस्तानों के पार संग चलता है

panels.shot: crossfade-style wide shot: desert caravan leading into Central Asian oasis town
panels.action: A line of travelers moves through desert toward a Central Asian oasis; in an inn-yard there, a monk recites a passage from Buddhacarita to a mixed local crowd by torchlight.

dialogue.text: From Gandhara to the Tarim Basin, in places like Turfan, fragments of Sanskrit, Prakrit and Gandhari texts took root, Ashvaghosha’s kind of verse living among many scripts and tongues.

i18n.hi: गांधार से तारिम मरु तक, तुर्फ़ान जैसे नगरों में, संस्कृत, प्राकृत और गांधीरी ग्रंथों के टुकड़े जड़ पकड़ते हैं, आश्वघोष के तरह की कविता कई लिपियों और ज़बानों के बीच बसती है

panels.shot: interior wide shot of a Chinese translation hall, Ashvaghosha as ghostly presence
panels.action: In a Chinese monastery hall centuries later, scholars like Kumarajiva sit with scribes, glossing an Indian manuscript; in a corner of the frame, a faint, respectful image of Ashvaghosha’s figure watches like a memory.

dialogue.text: In China, translators labored over his verses, turning Buddhacarita into new rhythms. Their biographies of him added legends, but beneath them the careful poet still speaks.

i18n.hi: चीन में अनुवादक उसके पद्य पर मेहनत करते हैं, ‘बुद्धचरित’ को नए छंदों में ढालते हैं। उनकी जीवनियाँ उसमें कथाएँ जोड़ती हैं, पर उन परतों के नीचे वही सजग कवि बोलता रहता है

panels.shot: medium shot of a Tibetan scribe at a low desk, mountain backdrop through window
panels.action: A Tibetan monk sits at a low desk, copying a Tibetan version of Ashvaghosha’s work, mountains rising beyond the window, prayer flags hanging still.

dialogue.text: Tibetan scribes, too, preserved his thought. His Buddha crossed snows and plateaus as lines in careful scripts, each copy a quiet act of remembrance along the Silk Road.

i18n.hi: तिब्बती लेखक भी उसकी सोच बचाते हैं। उनका बुद्ध हिम और पठार पार करता है, सँभाली लिपियों की पंक्तियों में, हर प्रति रेशम मार्ग पर एक शांत स्मरण

panels.shot: archaeological close-up on ancient manuscript fragments under soft light
panels.action: On a scholar’s table in the modern era, fragile Gandharan and Turfan manuscript fragments lie under glass, their faded Brahmi and Kharoṣṭhī letters lit by a gentle lamp.

dialogue.text: Today, Gandharan and Turfan fragments, Schoyen scrolls and old editions help scholars trace how texts like his moved and changed, revealing the Kushan age as a crossroads of pen and path.

i18n.hi: आज गांधारी और तुर्फ़ान के टुकड़े, शोयेन स्क्रोल और पुरानी पोथियाँ विद्वानों को दिखाती हैं कि उसके जैसे ग्रंथ कैसे चले और बदले, कुषाण युग को कलम और राह के संगम सा खोलती हैं

panels.shot: introspective close-up on Ashvaghosha looking slightly downward
panels.action: Ashvaghosha sits alone, scrolls piled beside him, eyes lowered in reflection, as if weighing the labor of poetry against the quiet of meditation.

dialogue.speaker: ashvaghosha
dialogue.text: If verse can turn a heart toward insight, the effort is small.

i18n.hi: अगर कविता किसी दिल को बोध की ओर मोड़ दे, तो परिश्रम छोटा है

panels.shot: sweeping wide shot of a timeline of readers across ages, with Ashvaghosha faintly superimposed
panels.action: A grand composite image: monks in Kushan robes, Chinese and Tibetan translators, modern readers in a library—all turning pages of Buddhacarita, with a translucent Ashvaghosha above, his scroll unrolling across centuries.

dialogue.text: Ashvaghosha’s legacy is not in legend but in lines: he showed that a well-told life can bear philosophy across empires and languages, turning distant doctrine into a story that stays.

i18n.hi: आश्वघोष की विरासत कथाओं में नहीं, पंक्तियों में है: उसने दिखाया कि सुना–सुनाया जीवन दर्शन को साम्राज्यों और भाषाओं के पार ले जा सकता है, दूर के सिद्धांत को ऐसी कहानी बना देता है जो मन में ठहर जाए

subtitle_i18n.en: In the Kushan twilight, a poet braids Buddha’s path into shining Sanskrit verse
subtitle_i18n.hi: कुषाण संध्या में कवि बुद्ध की राह को चमकती संस्कृत में बुनता है
